settings.title: Direct support
settings.text: Talk to people who build and drive this stuff. Same-day answers when you need a call on sizing, finish, or install.

settings.lede: Custom forged wheels, factory-backed builds, and fitment that holds up on the street.
settings.story_body:
We’re not a badge slapped on someone else’s wheels. Fortune Forged owns a stake in the factory that machines every set—so design, materials, finishing, and QC stay under one roof.

That means tighter control, clearer answers, and wheels that match what you ordered. From first sketch to final torque spec, the same team is accountable for how it looks and how it sits.
settings.build_intro: Less catalog fluff. More clearances, finishes, and people who answer the phone.
settings.mission_note: Forged strength, custom finishes, and fitment support from people who actually care how your car rolls out of the bay.
settings.close_text: Ready to spec a set? Tell us the car, the look, and how you drive—we’ll help lock the build.
